checks.reason: In Bessel coordinates the matrix [cos, <xi>sin/|xi|; -|xi|sin/<xi>, cos] is the correct wave group, bounded by C(1+t) and strongly continuous by dominated convergence. The integer-k Leibniz estimate makes B(b) bounded and norm-continuous on E_k, because the C^(k-1) norms of b are uniformly continuous on [0,L]x closed B_2R. No raw point trace or global E solution is used.

minor: Lines 52-54 have two slips. They call the fixed-mask column extension 'A_E=M_E L_chi', but fixed-mask (3) writes A_E=M_E Lpsi, with an auxiliary psi equal to 1 near supp chi, which contains B_(2R+L+1). That auxiliary psi is NOT the data psi=eta_R here, and the two should not be conflated. The same lines also say 'Our E driver is M_E; equivalently ... i^-1 A_F i', while Section 2 uses A_F i=i D_E with D_E=g M_E. The E Young driver should consistently be D_E=g M_E.

Section 3 does not state the uniform square-exponential source-driver moments that the fixed-mask Y3 upgrade to Lp needs. They follow from source-operator-convergence Theorem 1 (3) with C=1 plus actual-operator-driver (4). The cited Y3 is stated for the Theorem-2 source A^rho, not for the fast pullback. The transfer is standard and has accepted precedent in raw-block Section 7, but citing it explicitly would close the step.

GL fixes theta in (1/2, min(1-a/2,(3-a-alpha)/2)), while this note uses theta<beta. The note does not say that the Young flow is independent of the admissible theta. That follows from uniqueness in the larger-theta class, but should be stated.

GL is formulated on H_I (tests supported in (0,1)), while this note's W lives on the retaining extension of the full positive-time raw space. P_delta depends only on W restricted to the pulled-back fast tests on [0,L], so the two objects coincide. This should be said explicitly.

Identity (22) rests entirely on the accepted direct-event (S)-(M) and raw-block Section 8 canonical-series passage. The note's own time-change paragraph is a sketch of that input, not an independent proof. That is acceptable for accepted inputs, but its dependency should be read that way.

Section 5 applies fixed-mask-moment-transfer Sections 1 and 4 (continuous version, stationarity, Q_L) to the field g Y_fast through its law. This is valid because F Section 1 says only the single-rho law and the continuous version enter. Recording explicitly that the pathwise Section 4 construction needs only continuity and boundedness of the realized field would remove any doubt.
